name: CodePrism
summary: Builds a persistent code knowledge graph and exposes precise context to AI agents via MCP.
use_cases: get structured context for a function with callers and callees
scan proposed file changes for secrets before writing
analyze impact and blast radius before refactoring
track agent session reads and writes to avoid re-fetching
features: build persistent knowledge graph of codebase
answer callers, callees and impact queries

usage_guide.open_hint: Run `codeprism serve .` from your project folder, or add that command as an MCP server in your AI client.

features.feature: build persistent knowledge graph of codebase
features.title: Build a lasting knowledge graph of your code
steps: Start the server in your project folder with `codeprism serve .`.
From your MCP client, call the `index_project` tool with the path set to your project folder.

features.feature: answer callers, callees and impact queries
features.title: Find callers, callees and impact of code
steps: Start the server in your project folder with `codeprism serve .`.
Call the `get_callees` tool with the file and the function name, for example <file> and <function>.

features.title: Scan code changes for security issues
steps: Start the server in your project folder with `codeprism serve .`.
Call the `scan_diff` tool with the original text, the proposed text and the file name.

features.title: Give AI agents code context over MCP
steps: Start the server in your project folder with `codeprism serve .`.
Call the `get_context` tool with a file and a symbol name to get its context.

smoke_tests.command: cd demo_proj && python3 ~/.pickfit/mcp_probe.py --timeout 120 --call index_project --args '{"path":"."}' -- codeprism serve . 2>&1
cd demo_proj && python3 ~/.pickfit/mcp_probe.py --timeout 120 --call get_callees --args '{"file":"processor.py","function":"process_payment"}' -- codeprism serve . 2>&1
cd demo_proj && python3 ~/.pickfit/mcp_probe.py --timeout 120 --call scan_diff --args '{"original":"","proposed":"x = 1\n","file":"test.py"}' -- codeprism serve . 2>&1
cd demo_proj && python3 ~/.pickfit/mcp_probe.py --timeout 120 --call get_context --args '{"file":"processor.py","symbol":"process_payment"}' -- codeprism serve . 2>&1

what_it_does.quote: Standalone Python package + MCP server that builds and maintains a persistent knowledge graph of any codebase, exposing precise, token-efficient context to AI coding agents.
